name: rhongomiant-spellshroud-own-spell-cannot-target-it
notes: Rhongomiant, Grove's Spire (clS3E0HrZL, EXALTED/NORM WARRIOR REGALIA/WEAPON): "Spellshroud (Objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.)" -- the first, unconditional keyword; only its two [Mordred Bonus] clauses are conditional. Literal rules reading (comprehensive rules, Keywords > Spellshroud: "This can't be targeted by spells"; no "opponent's" qualifier, and FilterSpellshroudTargets() is controller-agnostic): the holder's controller's OWN spell cannot target it either. Player 1 plays its own Fracturize on its own turn with Rhongomiant and a Mirrordepth's Blade: only the Blade is offered, answering myField-1 is refused.

rulesClauses: Spellshroud: objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.
